name: Osteria Giulia
dinnerNote: À la carte; fish mains $65–$68, pasta $29–$55

menus.name: Convivio group menu
menus.note: Autumn 2026 family-style menu for groups of 8 to 10, from Ligurian snacks and focaccia through pasta, grilled seafood or lamb to dessert. Wine pairings available.

alsoTry.name: Giulietta
alsoTry.note: The same team's sister restaurant in Toronto.

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable only, up to 14 days ahead; each new day's tables are released at midnight Toronto time. Set an alert on OpenTable to hear of cancellations.
cancellation: Cancellations or smaller parties with less than 48 hours' notice cost $75 a guest; cutting the party by half or more may lose the booking. Tables are held for 15 minutes.
walkIns: Bar seats can be booked on OpenTable as a separate seating type.
groups: The largest table seats 10, and separate bookings can't be joined. Call to ask for a bigger party size. Groups of 8 to 10 can have the $140 Convivio menu.
children: Children and infants count in the party size when booking.
duration: Tables are reserved for 2 hours for two or three people, 2½ hours for four to seven and 3 hours for eight to ten.
byob: Corkage is $75 a 750ml bottle, up to two bottles a table. Outside cakes and desserts are not allowed.
